It is Monitor and not Not applicable because venue_object is the global mechanism and the schema permits it here; what is absent is stored rows, not the structure, on the same reasoning SPORTS/Modern-Pentathlon.md already applies to the incident and scope layers. GLOBAL-DQ-007.reason: Date of birth is populated for a minority: 1756 of 4212 athletes entered in the sport's events carry the property, so the check reports a majority of the population it reads. GLOBAL-DQ-082.reason: The template requires a tournament stage that groups a single discipline and forbids instantiation by a sport that legitimately runs several under one stage. This sport is one: a stage such as World Championships holds Fencing, Swimming, Riding, Laser Run and Overall events together, which is what a pentathlon is. Its whole population would be reported. The exclusion rests on how the sport composes a stage, not on how many stages hold several disciplines today.

Measured, the rule reports 32178 event participants, of which the points behind 30136 agree - correct records read as defects. GLOBAL-DQ-116 carries the same invariant against the score instead of the Comment and reports 2013, and GLOBAL-DQ-095 guards it on the statistic layer where the overall classification lives. The exclusion rests on how the sport scores a place, not on how many rows tie today.

GLOBAL-DQ-096.reason: The template requires a sport that names its events after the competitors taking part in them, and forbids instantiation by a sport whose event names are codes, distances or round labels. This sport names its events after the discipline and the segment - Fencing, Swimming Final, Semi-Final A - After Fencing - so no participant name appears in any of them and its whole population would be reported. The same conclusion follows independently from DUPLICATE_KEY_INCLUDES_EVENT_NAME being 1 here, which GLOBAL_DQ/README.md records as incompatible with instantiating this template. GLOBAL-DQ-083.reason: The template requires a competition model of H2H, where an event is a contest between exactly two entries. This sport is Listing: an event is a field ranked against itself, and SPORTS.md records the model as measured from the sport's data rather than assigned. Every event in the sport would be reported. The exclusion is structural and independent of how many participants any event holds today, so it does not rest on a row count.
